title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insecure… (CVE-2026-80269)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an insecure temporary file vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged attacker with local access to potentially gain unauthorized filesystem access. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-377 and has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.3.
